tools.name: list_references
tools.description: List the FIPE reference months and their codes. The first item is the latest month.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List the vehicle brands for a vehicle type.

vehicle_type.description: vehicle type: cars, motorcycles or trucks

reference.description: reference code from list_references; omit it for the latest month

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the models of a brand.

vehicle_type.description: vehicle type: cars, motorcycles or trucks

brand_code.description: brand code from list_brands, for example 59

reference.description: reference code from list_references; omit it for the latest month

tools.name: list_model_years
tools.description: List the model years and fuel types of a model.

vehicle_type.description: vehicle type: cars, motorcycles or trucks

brand_code.description: brand code from list_brands, for example 59

model_code.description: model code from list_models, for example 5940

reference.description: reference code from list_references; omit it for the latest month

tools.name: get_vehicle
tools.description: Get the FIPE price and the details of a vehicle from its brand, model and year codes.

vehicle_type.description: vehicle type: cars, motorcycles or trucks

brand_code.description: brand code from list_brands, for example 59

model_code.description: model code from list_models, for example 5940

year_code.description: year code from list_model_years, for example 2014-3

reference.description: reference code from list_references; omit it for the latest month

tools.name: list_years_by_fipe_code
tools.description: List the model years of a vehicle from its FIPE code.

vehicle_type.description: vehicle type: cars, motorcycles or trucks

reference.description: reference code from list_references; omit it for the latest month

tools.name: get_vehicle_by_fipe_code
tools.description: Get the FIPE price and the details of a vehicle from its FIPE code and year code.

vehicle_type.description: vehicle type: cars, motorcycles or trucks

year_code.description: year code from list_model_years, for example 2014-3

reference.description: reference code from list_references; omit it for the latest month

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Get the FIPE price history of a vehicle from its FIPE code and year code. Requires a paid subscription token.

vehicle_type.description: vehicle type: cars, motorcycles or trucks

year_code.description: year code from list_model_years, for example 2014-3

tools.name: get_vehicle_by_plate
tools.description: Get the vehicle data and the FIPE prices for a Brazilian license plate. Requires a subscription token.

plate.description: Brazilian license plate in the old format (ABC1234) or the Mercosul format (ABC1D23)
